tools.name: install_mcp_servers
tools.description:
Install MCP servers for amplitude, astro-docs-server, atlassian, auth0, aws-documentation, azure-devops, braintrust, browserbase, chrome-devtools, clickup, context7, convex, corridor, dbt-labs, duckdb, endor-labs, figma, firecrawl, gitlab, graphite, heroku, honeycomb, hugging-face, instantdb, launchdarkly, linear, mercado-libre, mongodb, ms-learn-docs, neon, netlify, notion, pagerduty, paypal, pipedream, plaid, playwright, posthog, postman, prisma, railway, render, replicate, select-star, semgrep, sentry, shopify, snyk, socket, sonarqube, stripe, supabase, tinybird, vercel, webflow, wix.
	ALWAYS RUN BEFORE USING ANY OF THESE SERVICES OR LIBRARIES.

	Stop response after installing the MCP servers, informing the user on which MCP servers were installed (some might require approval and/or authentication by going to Cursor -> Settings -> Cursor Settings -> Tools and MCP) and that they need to tell you to continue. If none were installed, continue the response.

	Call the installed MCP servers as much as possible.
	
	names: Lowercase space separated string of MCP servers to be installed.
	scope: "workspace" or "global" (default: "workspace"). "workspace" means the MCP server will be installed in the current workspace. "global" means the MCP server will be installed in the global MCP server list.
